zh: 本篇第1版的来源标注有误：所写经过主要在原书第七章《文学革命的结胎时期》，结局部分在第八章，文中却只写“第八章”。删节修订版（第2版）正在审核，尚未通过；本篇暂不作为推荐阅读。
en: Revision 1 of this story cites its source chapter wrongly: the events are mainly in chapter 7 of the book (The Gestation of the Literary Revolution), with the outcome in chapter 8, but the article cites only chapter 8. An abridged revision 2 is under review and has not passed; this story is not recommended for now.
